{{Top|leg}}
'''Bracers''' were worn around the wrists. [[Tyo]] often wore bracers of a nonconductive material, usually a thin layer of [[Synthskin/Legends|synthskin]] lined with [[duraplas]]. This was to counter the effects of [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]]; the material stopped the restraints from shocking those wearing them.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
